comment: The trace-review subagent's eval (CR-0036, roadmap 2.2.0, Theme P2): each case is a change, a patch against base, with the findings the subagent must report. A finding is matched by a line of the report that starts with its number ("1.", "2)", "[3]", "Finding 4") and names every one of its 'mentions'; 'none' is matched by a report that says "No findings" and numbers none. tools/agent_evals/score.py scores a report; the runs are kept in measurements/agent-evals/trace-review/.
